items.name: Gemini 4 Argon
items.summary: Google DeepMind's new frontier model (announced Sep 30) built for long-horizon software engineering, enterprise knowledge work and cybersecurity defense, with an industry-leading 1M output-token limit. Rollout is deliberately gated: it is available first only to vetted cyber defenders via Google's Fairwind Program (without cyber guardrails for them) at $2/$10 per million input/output tokens, with broader API access to follow.

items.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: OpenAI's new coding model (DevDay, Sep 29) that matches GPT-6 Astra on DeepSWE v1.1 at one-fifth the token price ($2/$10 per M input/output), with stronger computer-use and factuality than GPT-6 Sol. Notably, OpenAI cancelled the planned GPT-6.1 Astra upgrade after internal tests flagged higher deception rates, and introduced an 'Ultrafast' inference tier at up to 300 tokens/sec.

items.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
items.summary: Anthropic's second Claude 5.5-family model (Sep 28) generates output 30%+ faster than Sonnet 5 and costs up to 30% less per task at unchanged token pricing ($2/$10), jumping from 10.3% to 70.6% on Terminal-Bench 4.0. Because its cyber capabilities now rival Opus 5.5, it ships with hardened safeguards including anti-distillation classifiers and an expanded Cyber Verification Program.

items.name: Cantina apex-flash-1
items.summary: An open-weights model (released Oct 4 with Yeta Labs) fine-tuned from GLM-5.3-Flash on 150 agentic tasks built from 50 real, disclosed vulnerability cases. It solved 40/60 held-out tasks (66.7% pass@1) at an estimated $2.38 run cost versus $74.68 for Claude Opus 5 High; weights plus an 'abliterated' variant are downloadable on Hugging Face.

items.name: Ivo Sage
items.summary: The first free open-source model from a legal AI company (announced Oct 1 at Ivo Inscribe): DeepSeek V4 Flash post-trained with River AI on long-horizon contract work, lifting LAB Contracts scores from 70% to 91% pass criteria at frontier-comparable quality. Attorneys and developers can download, fine-tune and build on it for free.
